title: Small Business Support Grant Bondi Beach December 2025 – Terms and Conditions
summary: This document outlines the terms and conditions for applying for the Small Business Support Grant in Bondi Beach for December 2025.
who_can_apply: Must meet the eligibility criteria set out in the Guidelines and these Terms and Conditions.
what_you_need: Information or evidence required by the Guidelines.
The application must contain true and correct information.

internal_links.text: Small Business Support Grant Bondi Beach December 2025

faqs.q: Who are the terms and conditions for this grant applicable to?
faqs.a: These Terms and Conditions apply to the Program and the Critical Incident referred to in Appendix A.

faqs.q: What happens if I provide false or misleading information?
faqs.a: It is a serious offence to provide false or misleading information to a public authority, pursuant to the Crimes Act 1990 (NSW).

faqs.q: What must I do if I receive an Overpayment?
faqs.a: If you receive an Overpayment, you must repay it as directed by Service NSW within 28 days of their notice to you.

faqs.q: How can Service NSW recover grant payments?
faqs.a: Service NSW may take action to recover the whole or any part of the grant payment(s) if you fail to comply with the law, these Terms and Conditions, or the Guidelines.
